component.name: Filescape
component.summary: See what is taking up space on your drives

description.p: Filescape scans a drive or folder and draws everything on it as a map, where each file is a tile sized by how much space it takes. Big files and folders stand out at once.
Filter the map by name, size, type or age, find duplicates, compare snapshots over time and manage files in the built-in file manager, including on remote servers over SFTP and FTP.
